protocol_boundary.binary_wire_result_sender: serve_shared main loop; priority_reader reads that main sending task actual nice for HELLO/RESET/FRAME/GATE_RELEASE/STOP. Parent _accept remains unmodified.
protocol_boundary.AUTO_reply: AUTO START/POLL/CANCEL/CLOSE use JSON decode_status and TAKE uses decode_take; _rpc(decoder=...) does not call binary _accept nice assertion.
protocol_boundary.consumer: Ordinary capture/PCM/GTCRN call chain itself has no nice validator and emits no wire result.

official_Linux_basis.claim: Linux/NPTL nice is per-thread; fork/exec inheritance and restoration privilege still matter.

protocol_boundary.identity_limit: The three-task creation structure and hot442549/pump442550 CPU shape strongly support consumer mapping, but no public capture._thread.native_id or Python stack was exported. Do not call a GUI native_tid/get_ident field proof.
protocol_boundary.not_a_permission_grant: This is a local source review. Only the existing root exclusive operator may authorize and execute the bounded trial.

controlled_trial_boundaries.sole_operator: Identity/root under its own active exclusive phase; CPU performs no trial.
controlled_trial_boundaries.before_each_write: Fresh same boot, worker PID394769 birth3108205/command, target TID442549 birth3339743 and membership, capture generation, original priority/policy/affinity; the original snapshot is not an execution-time identity proof.
controlled_trial_boundaries.permitted_kernel_scope: Only PRIO_PROCESS with the exact current nonmain hot TID. Never IPC main, process group, all tasks, realtime policy or affinity.
controlled_trial_boundaries.abort: Speech/new TID/capture end/cancel/rearm/generation change, target disappearance, input or protocol error. Do not follow a replacement TID.
controlled_trial_boundaries.restoration: Finally restore-10 only while the original exact worker/TID lifetime still exists. Do not write an old numeric ID after exit/reuse; log target ended if no original state remains.
controlled_trial_boundaries.race: Numeric setpriority has no birth-CAS. Identity checks reduce but do not eliminate exit/reuse races. Trial must be withheld if the operator cannot accept or bound this residual condition.
controlled_trial_boundaries.inheritance: New Timer/threads born in the temporarily-normal consumer can inherit0; new task/speech invalidates strict single-variable interpretation. Existing pump/arecord do not change retrospectively.
controlled_trial_boundaries.quality: Consumer priority also affects dequeue. Historical nice0 queue overflow requires real audio-error/queue-quality evidence; retain original8-frame failure behavior, never discard PCM or suppress errors.
controlled_trial_boundaries.missing_queue_field: Child AUTO status contains input_queue, but RecordingController.public does not directly forward it. Missing visible fields are unknown, not zero or proof of spare capacity.
